title: India's Rivers and Lakes: Himalayan and Peninsular Systems

questions.question: The Ganga originates as the Bhagirathi from which glacier?
questions.rationale: The Bhagirathi rises at Gangotri and joins the Alaknanda at Devprayag to form the Ganga proper.

questions.question: Which tributary is called the 'sorrow of Bihar' for its shifting course and floods?
questions.rationale: The Kosi spreads a wandering alluvial fan over north Bihar, switching channels and flooding as it goes.

questions.question: The Brahmaputra is known in Tibet as the:
questions.rationale: The river is the Tsangpo in Tibet, becomes the Dihang/Siang in Arunachal Pradesh, and the Brahmaputra in Assam — the 'sorrow of Assam'.

questions.question: The largest peninsular river, honoured as the 'Dakshin Ganga', is the:
questions.rationale: The Godavari is the biggest of the peninsular rivers and is revered as the Ganga of the South.

questions.question: The Narmada and Tapi are unusual among Indian rivers because they:
options: Flow in rift valleys and end in estuaries
Flow east into the Bay of Bengal
questions.rationale: The two rivers run through fault-trough rift valleys westward to the Arabian Sea, ending in tide-scoured estuaries rather than deltas.

questions.question: Himalayan rivers flow year-round chiefly because:
options: They are fed by both monsoon rain and snowmelt
They receive winter rainfall from the western disturbances only
questions.rationale: The perennial regime of Himalayan rivers combines summer monsoon rain with continuing snow and glacier melt, unlike seasonal peninsular rivers.

questions.question: Majuli, one of the world's largest inhabited river islands, stands in the:
questions.rationale: Majuli lies midstream in the Brahmaputra in Assam, upstream of the river's flood-prone lower course.

questions.question: India's largest freshwater lake is:
questions.rationale: Wular in Jammu & Kashmir, fed by the Jhelum, is the largest freshwater lake; Chilika is brackish and Sambhar is salt.

questions.question: Chilika, India's largest brackish-water lagoon, lies in:
questions.rationale: Chilika in Odisha is a shallow lagoon separated from the sea by a sand bar — a lagoon, not a true lake.

questions.question: Sambhar Lake in Rajasthan is famous as:
questions.rationale: Sambhar is India's largest inland salt lake; Lonar is the crater lake and Vembanad the longest.
